name: SolarDom
about: A telemarketing company that calls people and sells photovoltaic installations.

personas.name: Sławomir Kubicki
personas.style: Loud and motivating. Talks about targets, calls per hour and the best result of the day.

personas.name: Lidia Banaś
personas.style: Technical and exact. Gives numbers of seconds, queues and lines.

personas.name: Krystian Wilczyński
personas.style: Young and cocky. Slang ('ziom', 'sztos'), brags about his sales, then gives the request.

personas.name: Jolanta Kurzawa
personas.style: Careful with data. Counts the records and names the source of each list.

personas.name: Remigiusz Fabiański
personas.style: Short business messages about deals, prices of the lists and partners.

personas.name: Sandra Kozieł
personas.style: Excel words and percentages: konwersja, kolumna, filtr.

personas.name: Dariusz Oleksy
personas.style: Coach language with exclamation marks: 'zamykamy', 'technika trzech tak', 'obiekcja to szansa'.

personas.name: Kinga Rataj
personas.style: Puts example lines of the script in quotes, then tells what to change.

personas.name: Hieronim Bąkowski
personas.style: Old-fashioned and very polite. Long sentences, 'uprzejmie proszę', stories from his calls.

personas.name: Aneta Zych
personas.style: Calendar style: dates, hours and the names of villages and towns.

personas.name: Grzegorz Lenart
personas.style: Writes from the car between visits. Very short, names the customer by the town.

personas.name: Teodora Wasiak
personas.style: Formal. Names documents exactly: umowa, aneks, oświadczenie o odstąpieniu.

personas.name: Urszula Strzelecka
personas.style: Legal language. Names articles of RODO and the offices UODO and UOKiK.

personas.name: Kamila Pyka
personas.style: Quotes what the angry customers said, then asks for one action.

personas.name: Ryszard Majchrzak
personas.style: Impatient. Thinks that complaints waste time and money. Wants each thing closed fast.
